name: block-edit
description: Two screenshots from the same camera pose, before and after REMOVING the block under the crosshair. Comparing two images is weaker than judging one (docs: keep questions simple); treat results as experimental. The exact voxel is known to the test scenario, not to this tool.

different_view.instructions: Does `after` show a different viewpoint or a different landscape than `before`, not only a small change?

notch_in_after.instructions: Does `after` have a notch or pit in the ground near the centre of the image that `before` does not have?

notch_in_before.instructions: Does `before` have a notch or pit in the ground near the centre of the image?

notch_location.instructions: Where is the notch or pit near the centre of `after`?

large_change_far_from_centre.instructions: Besides the centre, are there large differences between `before` and `after` near the edges of the image?
